payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute palindrome start/end counts via center expansion, then count non-overlapping pairs by summing products of end and start counts for all i < j.
payload.rationale: The solution uses combinatorial multiplication of precomputed counts rather than dynamic programming. Among the given DP subtypes, dp_counting_combinatorics best fits the counting/combinatorial nature, though no explicit DP recurrence is used.
